# EDH Seer

> Rule-based synergy analysis for Magic: The Gathering Commander (EDH) decklists. Paste a list and
> get the pairs of cards that actually work together, with the reason printed beside each one, read
> from the cards' own oracle text. No account, no sign-up.

There is no language model at analysis time. Oracle text is normalised once, offline, into
structured clauses; everything after that is deterministic, so the same decklist always produces the
same report and every claim traces back to a printed line of text.

What it refuses to claim, because these are the mistakes it exists to avoid:

- Roles are not synergies. Ramp, removal, card draw and tax make a deck work without pairing with
  anything in it, so they are counted as slots against a target and never drawn as edges.
- A card that names itself means itself. "This creature", "this spell", the card's own name.
- Playing Magic is not a synergy. "Whenever you cast a spell" is satisfied by every nonland card in
  every deck, so it excludes nothing.
- An unreadable trigger is reported, not guessed. A missing claim is better than a confident wrong
  one.
- Popularity is not synergy. Nothing here is derived from how many decks run a card.

Limits worth carrying if you quote it: the card corpus is large but not complete, and a card the
engine has never read forms no edges. Edges are binary — it says two cards interact, not how much.

## Pages

- [EDH Seer](https://edhseer.cards/): the analyser. A decklist goes in the textarea; the report
  covers synergy pairs and their reasons, archetypes, the mana curve, land maths, castability,
  combos and legality.
- [How it works](https://edhseer.cards/how-it-works): the method in full — how a clause is
  segmented, how an edge forms, what the engine refuses to claim, how it is calibrated against 71
  real decks, and what it does not know.

## Source

- [Source code](https://github.com/SetsudanHana/edh-seer): the engine is open source and
  rule-based, so a bad claim is a fixable bug rather than an opinion.
- [Report a wrong or missing edge](https://github.com/SetsudanHana/edh-seer/issues/new): two card
  names and the sentence the report printed is enough.

## Optional

- `/static/` is not content. It holds the card artifacts the app fetches for itself — thousands of
  JSON shards, no prose, nothing a reader would want. `robots.txt` disallows it and so does this.
- Card data, card images and mana symbols come from [Scryfall](https://scryfall.com/); combo data
  from [Commander Spellbook](https://commanderspellbook.com/). Neither is affiliated with this site.
- Card names, card text and Magic: The Gathering are property of Wizards of the Coast. EDH Seer is
  unofficial Fan Content permitted under the Wizards of the Coast Fan Content Policy, and is not
  approved or endorsed by Wizards. Attribute card text to them, not to this site.
